entities.serves: All clients outside the United States (India, Middle East, Europe, rest of world)
entities.default_law: India (arbitration seated in Pune or Mumbai)

entities.serves: Clients in the United States only

rules: US client → AtliQ Inc must be the contracting party and the invoicing entity.
Non-US client → AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd must be the contracting party and the invoicing entity.
Contracting entity and invoicing entity must be the same (mismatch caused payment delays twice in 2025).
Any other AtliQ name (e.g. 'AtliQ Global', 'AtliQ LLP') is not a real entity → serious.
Governing law: Indian law for Pvt Ltd, US state law for Inc. Foreign law/courts where AtliQ has no presence → negotiable (Brightwater lesson).
Both entities deliver from Pune; AtliQ Inc subcontracts delivery to Pvt Ltd (intercompany). Pvt Ltd is an Affiliate of Inc and vice versa.
